raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
`skills-checks.yml` calls a deleted `amd/skills` reusable workflow, causing every run to fail before creating jobs.

- **Remove obsolete gate:** Delete the workflow, including its stale federation documentation link.
- **Preserve skill validation:** Leave the existing `skill-evals.yml` skillscope workflow and local evaluation dataset unchanged.

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->

- Fixes #1056
